data.fund_name: DSP Global Innovation Overseas Equity Omni FoF
data.fund_type: An open ended fund of fund scheme investing in Innovation theme
data.investment_objective: The primary investment objective of the scheme is to seek capital appreciation by investing in global mutual funds schemes and ETFs that primarily invest in companies with innovation theme having potential for higher revenue and earnings growth. The Scheme may also invest a certain portion of its corpus in money market securities and/or money market/liquid schemes of DSP Mutual Fund, in order to meet liquidity requirements from time to time. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: 1. Units of Innovation funds - 95% to 100% 2. Money market securities and/or units of money market/liquid schemes of DSP Mutual Fund - 0% to 5%
data.benchmark: MSCI All Country World Index - Net Total Return
